meaning.en: Gasping with or as with the heaves.
meaning.vi: Thở hổn hển khi thở gấp.

meaning.en: (of horses) Having short breath or disordered respiration.
meaning.vi: (ngựa) Khó thở hoặc rối loạn hô hấp.
